Troubleshoot

Pick the symptom that best describes the problem. You'll get a checklist you can follow on your phone.

  • A cable is crackling or cutting out
  • No sound at all
  • Feedback or squealing
  • Stage monitor is too quiet
  • Board settings changed after the other congregation used it
  • Condenser mic has no signal (phantom power may be off)
  • Wireless mic drops out or has static
  • The room sounds bad but nothing specific is broken
  • Volunteer cannot figure out the board
  • A channel sounds distorted or clipped
  • Constant hum or buzz in the speakers
  • Feedback only in a stage monitor

Suggestions on this site are guidance, not professional advice. If you are unsure, stop and ask an experienced sound engineer.
